accounts_identifier_check.name: accounts_identifier_check
accounts_identifier_check.value: ("accounts"."identifier_kind" is null and "accounts"."identifier" is null) or ("accounts"."type" = 'bank' and "accounts"."identifier" is not null and "accounts"."identifier_kind" in ('accountNumber', 'cardNumber', 'sheba'))

transactions_transfer_check.name: transactions_transfer_check
transactions_transfer_check.value: case when "transactions"."type" = 'transfer' then "transactions"."to_account_id" is not null and "transactions"."to_account_id" <> "transactions"."account_id" and "transactions"."category_id" is null else "transactions"."to_account_id" is null end
